plan.status: Follow-up after the main frozen test evaluation; the test split has been seen, so results are exploratory and are reported separately from the main study.
plan.frozen_inputs: docs/arena_selection.json chooses the CNN and LSTM recipes; no new candidates, epochs, or hyperparameters are searched.

learning_curve.sampling: Per-class random subset of the training split, drawn with numpy default_rng([seed, fraction*1000]); validation and test are the unchanged full splits.
learning_curve.full_data_point: Reuses the existing main-study fits (seeds 1448-1450; char TF-IDF single fit) at fraction 1.0.

posthoc.matched_pairs: Test battles whose two sides were both retained: identical prompt, two different authors.
posthoc.mask_free: Test rows whose answer contains no [MODEL] placeholder.
posthoc.equal_length: Frozen models read exactly the first 128 answer tokens of every test answer with at least 128 tokens.
posthoc.window_position: Frozen models read 192-token first, middle, and last windows of test answers with at least 576 tokens.
posthoc.ensemble: Average class probabilities of CNN (3-seed mean), LSTM (3-seed mean), and char TF-IDF. Weights on a 0.05 simplex grid maximize validation macro-F1; the equal-weight average is reported too.
posthoc.cnn_ngrams: Seed-1448 CNN on training answers only: n-grams at the max-pooled position of the filters that contribute most to the correct class.

plan.uncertainty: 2,000 paired resamples of test duplicate groups, seed 1448, matching the main study.
